title: UMA-AQ adapter: code for adapting UMA to spin-polarized AQCat25 with task-gated LoRA
description: Code for the paper "Adapting UMA to spin-polarized AQCat25 without catastrophic forgetting with task-gated LoRA" (ChemRxiv, doi:10.26434/chemrxiv.15010987): adding an aqcat25 task to UMA-S-1p2, task-gated LoRA training on fairchem-core 2.23.0, the final evaluation, the zero-shot UMA and EV2-FiLM baselines, and the scripts that rebuild every table and figure. Predictions and logs: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23860707. Adapter weights (on request): doi:10.5281/zenodo.23860868. The code contains no UMA weights and no AQCat25 data; those are obtained under their own licenses (FAIR Chemistry License v1; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
